name: Swinburne Indigenous Financial Assistance Grant
summary: A $1,000 one-off grant for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Swinburne students facing an emergency or hardship.
who: Australian citizen of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander heritage.
A Swinburne student in 2026 who has completed at least one semester, full-time or part-time.
Assessed on the emergency or hardship and its impact on study.
how: Submit the online form with a personal statement (up to 500 words), proof of heritage and evidence of the hardship.

evidence.quote: be of Australian Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander heritage
